import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Create a pandas DataFrame from the dataset
data = """
amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5
"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Pivot the DataFrame to count the number of transactions by hour of day
hourly_transactions = df.pivot_table(index='hour_of_day', columns='transaction_type', values='amount', aggfunc='count')

# Plot the resulting pivot table as a bar chart
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x=hourly_transactions.columns, y=hourly_transactions.iloc[0], data=hourly_transactions)
plt.title('Number of Transactions by Hour of Day')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Number of Transactions')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the plot to output.png

plt.close()

amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5
"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Pivot the DataFrame to count the number of transactions by hour of day
hourly_transactions = df.pivot_table(index='hour_of_day', columns='transaction_type', values='amount', aggfunc='count')

# Plot the resulting pivot table as a bar chart
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x=hourly_transactions.columns, y=hourly_transactions.iloc[0], data=hourly_transactions)
plt.title('Number of Transactions by Hour of Day')
